title: trichera arvensis subsp. pannonica
intro: Trichera arvensis subsp. pannonica, commonly known as Hungarian chamomile, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family, used for its medicinal properties. It is known to possess several health benefits, including its calming effects, ability to reduce inflammation, and antimicrobial properties, making it a popular natural remedy for soothing digestive issues and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Trichera arvensis subsp. pannonica include its sedative and anti-anxiety effects, as well as its ability to aid in sleep disorders and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
